reviews.title: Amazing Golens x95 smart lock good purchase
reviews.body: Works well so far: fingerprint, PIN and face unlock. Installed the Golens X95 17 days ago and it has worked satisfactorily with no issues. Installation was smooth, and registering fingerprints, PINs and faces was simple. Fingerprint and face unlock are quick and accurate, and the PIN is handy for guests. The build feels sturdy and the finish looks neat. Too early to comment on long-term durability and battery life, but so far it has met my expectations. Will update after a few months. Strongly recommended.
